title: Implement Analyze CodeLens For All Definitions In VS Code
description: Ensure every definition in the semio-repo VS Code extension shows an Analyze code lens across all programming languages and native definition kinds, including TypeScript const, function, class, interface and equivalent symbolized definitions. Remove the symbol-matching gaps and extend existing extension tests accordingly.
summary: Implemented Analyze CodeLens emission for nested definition entity IDs in the semio-repo VS Code extension and extended the existing extension tests to verify Analyze lenses across representative TypeScript and Go definition sources.
